[Colorless] Grind 10× — Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Wobbuffet.
[Psychic][Psychic][Colorless] Shadow Tag — Put 7 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn.

Poké-Body: Poison Payback — If Wurmple is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Wurmple is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.
[Colorless] String Pull — Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.
